verdict.rationale: Grok Build is documented as a local coding agent, used through a TUI, headless scripting, or ACP, with local sandboxing, worktrees and background tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows a cloud-hosted agent that builds, tests and produces a demo of a feature for review. Local background tasks and session sharing are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
